input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us (Section 23 is a bare heading with no record-keeping or assurance obligation, and no other inspection, verification, monitoring or remote-access right exists elsewhere). It meets every preferred element: audits are limited to once in any twelve-month period on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality; Vendor bears audit costs unless the audit establishes underpayment exceeding five percent; and Vendor and its auditor may not access Customer systems directly. Section 22.2 also blocks access to unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information, and Section 22.3 treats findings as our Confidential Information — both in our favour. No redline required.
